pairs.old: CMS has begun incorporating PROs into several programs: joint replacement bundles require functional outcome reporting, MIPS has PRO-based quality measures, and the ACO PC Flex model incorporates patient experience measures.
pairs.new: CMS has begun incorporating PROs into several programs: the CJR joint replacement model rewarded hospitals for submitting HOOS JR and KOOS JR functional outcome data, the Hospital IQR Program adopted a hip and knee replacement PRO performance measure, and MIPS includes PRO-based quality measures.
pairs.claim: fallback callout: joint replacement bundles 'require' functional outcome reporting; ACO PC Flex 'incorporates patient experience measures' (patient experience is not a PRO)
pairs.src: CMS CJR: voluntary PRO data submission rewarded in composite quality score since 2016; Hospital IQR THA/TKA PRO-PM (matches lesson body pro-p9/pro-p12)
